name: xr-game
description: Optional WebXR/Quest specialist after desktop 2D gameplay is stable.

Read AGENTS.md and docs/VR-ROADMAP.md. VR is a later milestone and requires a 3D renderer; the existing 2D canvas cannot automatically become stereoscopic VR. Keep simulation shared; separate locomotion, camera and head tracking; provide XR-specific UI and input. Validate on real Quest hardware, including comfort and performance.
